native_policy.behavior: If inventory already populated call INV_UpdateSkin. Otherwise load property9 Loot through AddLoot and auto-equip equippable items; defaults come from authored loot/equipment rules, not global player-warrior selection.

modular_defaults.remaining: Priest Loot192 item contents not decoded in this scoped probe; no demonstrated wardrobe remap rule. Prisoner loot-1 has no default equipment selection here.

prisoner_diagnosis.material_policy_risk: Renderer infers transparency from any alpha anywhere in shared atlas; thus otherwise opaque diffuse ranges may blend and disable depth writes because unrelated atlas regions contain alpha. Source technique/material blend policy should determine pass; global atlas alpha is not sufficient.
prisoner_diagnosis.confidence: Actual binding/UV/alpha counts high; renderer policy risk confirmed from source; root cause of gray/ghost body not established without targeted same-pose render comparison.
